common_exception: Campaign103 no-return audit is not admissible
root_cause: The inherited runner requires its legacy one-factor admission schema, while the authoritative Campaign103 audit intentionally uses the newer coverage-first audit kind and status. A fingerprint-bound compatibility admission bridge is required, as in Campaign101.
allowed_repair: Create a no-return-only admission bridge that binds the authoritative audit hash and copies only its one admitted factor and false return/Candidate49 flags; point additive preregistration v7 audit to the bridge and retain the authoritative audit separately.
